During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the exclusive [[Manarai]] restaurant on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served '''drezzle sauce'''.

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], drezzle sauce was a component of a [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] meal served to [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]], by which Koozar was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]].
